name_zh: 京张接单 CALL 五态
name_en: Jingzhang Takes the Call — CALL five-state protocol

ledgers.purpose: problem, channel, owner, acceptance/referral/closure and first response
next action, time box, responsible person, data boundary, human gate and status
closure reason, maintenance cost structure, reusable component, contributor and next referral

tool_boundaries.agent: Draft scene orders, suggest matches and summarize evidence; never accept, approve, procure or close a real case.
tool_boundaries.workflow: Run stable repeated completeness checks, reminders, version comparisons and archival steps.
tool_boundaries.codex: Maintain the structured bilingual package, geometry, metrics, renders and verification scripts.
tool_boundaries.human: Own the problem, professional judgment, site safety, adoption/rejection, appeal and exit.

phases.gate: Three existing processes can complete Capture, Assign, Limit and Learn with named human owners.
Staffing, authorization, non-digital fallback, monthly closure and exit are demonstrated.
Field baselines and professional review justify expansion; fixed construction follows statutory procedure.
